semanticDescription: A small dark card on a violet glow: a document icon with a 'TEXT' tag chip, 'Project Brief.txt' filename and '97.45 KB' size, an 'Uploading... 74%' progress bar with a spinner, and a close (x) button top-right.
styleSummary: Upload Toast Card: compact dark notification, single violet glow accent, icon + metadata + live progress bar.

composition.depth: card floats on a soft glow, otherwise flat
composition.framing: small card, generous surrounding dark space

typography.characteristics: clean geometric sans, restrained sizes typical of real product chrome
typography.animation: filename/meta fade in with the card; percentage ticks up live

color.notes: single violet accent for glow and progress fill

motion.primaryMotion: progress bar fills left-to-right in sync with a counting percentage
motion.secondaryMotion: spinner rotates continuously (ambient, not tied to progress); card slides/scales up on entrance with the glow blooming beneath it

motion.stagger: icon/tag arrive with the card; text and bar follow immediately after
